features.title: Deny tool calls outright, after permissions
features.summary: A global tool guard refuses any call whose tool name matches a rule's glob and whose JSON arguments match its pattern, whatever the approval policy or sandbox mode allowed; the agent can list and dry-run the rules but never change them.

configuration.constraints: Each rule: name, tool glob (`*` wildcard), match regular expression over the JSON arguments (empty matches every call), reason, enabled.

failureModes: A rule whose pattern does not compile denies every call of its tool, so a broken policy fails closed.
Settings that cannot be read leave no rule active and log nothing to the model.

verification.testName: matches the tool glob and the argument pattern, and skips disabled rules
fails closed on a pattern that does not compile
denies a matching call before its tool runs and lets other calls through

telemetry.reason: A synchronous in-memory check inside the native tool guard; the denied call is already recorded by the agent-tool span and the session log.
